profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I am a software developer that has broad-based skills in web, desktop, mobile applications and cloud services. I can move effortless through and adapt readily to ever-changing technologies. I designed and built infrastructure and web services at large scale. I also have experience in building roadmap, strategy for teams, and mentoring junior engineers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I am in Microsoft Security team. I have been working on security information and event management (SIEM) services and infrastructure to minimize Microsoft and its customers’ risk by proactive threat detection, investigation, and response.

positions.description: Worked on Surface, Microsoft Band, Azure Security services such as Azure Sentinel, Intelligent Graph Security... Designed and built infrastructure and web services at large scale.
